definitions.explanation: A small wheeled cart pushed or pulled by hand, used for transporting goods or materials. Common in markets, warehouses, and construction sites.

examples.japanese: {手車|てぐるま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{運|はこ}ぶ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧。
⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{手車|てぐるま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{移動|いどう}→移動：01741_idou⟧⟦させている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At the market, goods are moved by handcart.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{資材|しざい}→資材：19470_shizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{手車|てぐるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せて→載せる：28290_noseru⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{運|はこ}んだ→運ぶ：01088_hakobu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: I loaded the heavy materials onto a handcart and transported them to the site, but pushing it alone on the slope was tough.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) and ⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧ (cart/vehicle). Refers to a simple wheeled vehicle designed to be pushed or pulled by hand, without mechanical power.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手車|てぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: push a handcart
- {手車|てぐるま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: pull a handcart
- {手車|てぐるま}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{載|の}せる→載せる：28290_noseru⟧: load onto a handcart

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{台車|だいしゃ}→台車：18474_daisha⟧: dolly; wheeled platform cart (the most common modern term for hand-pushed carts)
- ⟦{一輪車|いちりんしゃ}→一輪車：15186_ichirinsha⟧: wheelbarrow (single-wheeled cart)
- ⟦{荷車|にぐるま}→荷車：14242_niguruma⟧: cargo cart (larger cart for heavy loads, sometimes animal-drawn)
- リヤカー: rear car; bicycle trailer (a two-wheeled cart towed behind a bicycle)
